profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC, with CIK 0001818201. The website associated with the company in the data is calgoncarbon.com.

The text drawn from that site describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon provider addressing air and water purification. It describes FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated coal-based activated carbon, as proven by over 40 years of use in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings. The site states that FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The record lists no lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company. It lists Illinois with a law exposure count of 339.
